description.p: LumaEdge transforms computer monitors into soft, diffused virtual ring lights. Inspired by Apple macOS Edge Light, LumaEdge illuminates faces during video calls, online meetings, streaming, and recording in low-light environments without requiring external ring light hardware.

Features hardware-accelerated GPU shader rendering, Planckian colour temperature calibration (2700K - 6500K), smooth corner blending, multi-monitor support, and non-blocking click-through desktop overlay.
Initial release of LumaEdge for Linux desktop.
